spanish: Entonces cantaba Moisés e hijos de Israel este cántico a Jehová, y dijeron, diciendo: ¡Cantaré a Jehová, porque exaltando exaltó; caballo y su jinete arrojó en el mar!
grammarChanges: cantó → cantaba, keeping the qal imperfect 3ms open instead of a closed preterite
removed the unmarked se between exaltando and exaltó, since the qal infinitive absolute plus qal perfect 3ms carries no reflexive, middle, or object pronoun in the source
Cantaré kept as a future but framed with an exclamation to carry the cohortative's volitive force
readerNote: Changed cantó to cantaba to keep the qal imperfect open rather than a closed preterite, removed the unmarked se between exaltando and exaltó because the source infinitive absolute plus perfect carries no reflexive or object pronoun, and marked Cantaré's cohortative force with an exclamation instead of a reworded verb.
